create_sinusoid_position_encoding: create sinusoidal positional encodings for a sequence with given length and hidden size
apply_rotary_encoding: apply rotary positional encoding (RoPE) to query or key tensors for attention
compute_attention_with_relative_encoding: compute attention logits with relative positional encodings following Transformer-XL
compute_alibi_encodings_biases: compute ALiBi linear bias matrices for multi-head attention based on head count and sequence lengths
shift_relative_logits: shift relative attention logits for causal or non-causal relative positional encoding
